 News Flash 
 Update on Water and Sewer Billing Delays and Software 
The Athens-Clarke County Unified Government (ACCGov) Public Utilities Department is working to address delays that have affected the timing of utility bills for some customers. Read on... 
 Second Absentee Ballot Mistakenly Mailed to 1,154 Athens-Clarke County Voters 
A second absentee ballot was mistakenly mailed to 1,154 voters due to a mailing list error. Since ballots are tied to individual voters, the statewide elections system prevents duplicate ballots from being cast. Read on... 
 UPDATED: Building Permits & Inspections Launches New Online Portal for Permit Submissions 
ACCGov’s Building Permits & Inspections Department is now accepting digital permit applications through a new online portal. Starting January 1, 2027, an extended deadline, all permits must be submitted through the new online system. Read on... 
 James Alexander Appointed ACCGov Central Services Department Director 
ACCGov Manager Bob Cowell has appointed James Alexander to serve as the Central Services Department Director as of September 28. Alexander has served as interim director of the department since July 2024. Read on...
